version 15.2
hostname rt-q01
!
class-map match-any cm-q-voice
 match dscp ef
class-map match-any cm-q-biz
 match access-group name acl-q-biz
!
policy-map pm-q-child
 class cm-q-voice
  priority percent 20
 class cm-q-biz
  bandwidth remaining percent 40
 class class-default
  fair-queue
policy-map pm-q-wan
 class class-default
  shape average 10000000
  service-policy pm-q-child
policy-map pm-q-lan
 class cm-q-biz
  police cir 5000000 conform-action transmit exceed-action drop
  set dscp af21
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 service-policy output pm-q-wan
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 service-policy input pm-q-lan
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.2
!
ip access-list extended acl-q-biz
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
!
end
